variants.name: Read
variants.desc: Reads a little book, eyes following each line, flipping pages as it goes.

variants.name: Ring
variants.desc: A loading ring circles it and the eyes chase the leading edge.

variants.name: Juggle
variants.desc: Juggles three balls off the top of its head, eyes tracking each throw.

variants.name: Dots
variants.desc: Three dots bounce overhead and the eyes follow them across.

variants.name: Dig
variants.desc: Shovels side to side, flicking bits of data over its shoulders.

parts.t: <g class="fx-ring"><circle class="trk" cx="50" cy="50" r="47"></circle><circle class="a arc" cx="50" cy="50" r="47"></circle></g>

<g class="fx-juggle" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(50 4)"><circle class="a ball" r="5" fill="currentColor"></circle><circle class="a ball" r="5" fill="#F2B33D"></circle><circle class="a ball" r="5" fill="#F27863"></circle></g></g>

<g class="fx-dots" fill="currentColor" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><circle class="a" cx="37" cy="3" r="5.5"></circle><circle class="a" cx="50" cy="3" r="5.5"></circle><circle class="a" cx="63" cy="3" r="5.5"></circle></g>
